label: smoke
timing_note: sim = Gazebo /clock, wall = host monotonic; stand-in decides on wall clock (steady)
cpu_basis: container = cgroup usage_usec delta over the window (includes the worker and recorder); host_busy = /proc/stat all CPUs (includes other containers); by_process = utime+stime per comm, live processes only
distance_basis: path length integrated from /odom (ground-truth odometry) over the window
hb_gaps_basis: gaps between consecutive oomwoo/health/mcu_heartbeat messages seen by the recorder process (same QoS as the stand-in), wall clock; the stand-in's own view is not exposed
